name: HMS Belfast
type: museum ship; light cruiser; national museum; preserved watercraft
text: HMS Belfast is a Town-class light cruiser that was built for the Royal Navy. She is permanently moored as a museum ship on the River Thames in London and is operated by the Imperial War Museum. Construction of Belfast, the first ship in the Royal Navy to be named after the capital of Northern Ireland and one of 10 Town-class cruisers, began in December 1936.
